summary.en: Hard Rock fills a sports cathedral and somehow still feels dangerous.
summary.zh: Hard Rock 填满一座体育教堂，却仍危险。

whyEpic.en: Madison Square Garden nights from this era freeze the Zeppelin template: stop-start dynamics, Bonham weather, Plant sailing screams across concrete. The Song Remains the Same lore turns a tour into scripture—love it or side-eye it, the scale sticks.
whyEpic.zh: 这个时期的花园广场之夜冻住了 Zeppelin 模板：骤停骤起、Bonham 的天气、Plant 的嚎掠过水泥。The Song Remains the Same 传说把巡演写成经文——爱或侧目，尺度都粘住了。
